name: old_alias_branch
source: {% set ns=namespace(xs=[], old=[]) %}{% for i in range(300) %}{% set ns.xs=ns.xs+[i] %}{% if i==199 %}{% set ns.old=ns.xs %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% set branch=ns.old+[999] %}{{ ns.old|length }}:{{ ns.old[-1] }}|{{ ns.xs|length }}:{{ ns.xs[-1] }}|{{ branch|length }}:{{ branch[-1] }}

name: iterate_old_while_append
source: {% set ns=namespace(xs=(range(160)|list)+[160], count=0) %}{% for i in ns.xs %}{% set ns.xs=ns.xs+[i] %}{% set ns.count=ns.count+1 %}{% if loop.first or loop.last %}{{ loop.index }}:{{ loop.length }}:{{ loop.last }}|{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.count }}:{{ ns.xs|length }}

name: empty_identity
source: {% set a=(range(160)|list)+[160] %}{% set alias=a %}{% set b=a+[] %}{{ a is sameas alias }}:{{ a is sameas b }}:{{ a==b }}

name: shallow_namespace

name: tuple_concat

name: macro_nested_unicode
source: {% macro m(x) %}{% set n=namespace(v=[]) %}{% for i in range(260) %}{% if i%2==0 %}{% set n.v=n.v+[x~i] %}{% else %}{% set n.v=n.v+['中文🧪'] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ n.v|length }}:{{ n.v[0] }}:{{ n.v[-1] }}{% endmacro %}{{ m('é') }}|{{ m('傅里叶') }}

name: alternating_chains
